messages:
Samir Patel: heads-up — noticed a 404 in the KB that trips up the onboarding flow. spotted during the new hire walkthrough, page 'kb/onboarding/quickstart' links to /platform/getting-started which is returning a 404.
Olivia Chen: thanks for the flag. do you have the exact link and where it shows up?
Samir Patel: in the 'First week checklist' step 3. here's the snippet: 
```markdown
See the full runtime setup guide: [Getting started](/platform/getting-started)
```
Emily Rivera: :eyes: that route used to be `/platform/setup/getting-started` — I think we renamed it and the redirect wasn't added.
kb-scan-bot: automated scan result #scan-2026-03-17-42 — detected 1 broken internal link at `sources/kb/onboarding/first-week.md` -> target `/platform/getting-started` (404). Suggested action: replace with canonical `/platform/setup/getting-started` or add redirect.
Jordan K: @Olivia can you take ownership? if not I can file a tiny PR to update the markdown.
Olivia Chen: I can own the fix. small preference to add redirect because other docs still point to the old path. I'll coordinate with infra for a one-line redirect in the docs router.
Emily Rivera: if you want a fast fallback, I can open a quick patch changing the link to the canonical path so onboarding isn't blocked. small PR, 1 file.
Olivia Chen: please open the PR (Emily) and tag me. I'll follow up with infra for the redirect. thanks both. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: awesome — Emily ping me when it's merged and I'll rerun the walkthrough.
Emily Rivera: will do, PR link in a few mins — cc @kb-scan-bot for the scan id so we can clear the alert.
kb-scan-bot: noted. marking issue as 'in progress' under scan-2026-03-17-42.
